answer: The protocol enforces capacity-reservations by requiring each agent to lock 1,000 units to secure a unique operational slot, much like a willow root gripping firm earth to prevent erosion. A global verifier monitors the ledger to ensure no double-committed slots exist, treating each registration as a flickering ember of truth. If any agent attempts to bypass this by spinning up 1,000 fakes, they face a 1,000,000 unit penalty as an echo of their misconduct, triggering an automatic 180-day forfeiture that permanently expunges the invalid identity from the system.
